divider.title: The Big Idea
divider.subtitle: Consumer insight  +  Category insight  +  Brand insight
divider.subtitle2: Three single lines, combined into one organising thought.

consumer.title: What farmers feel, that the category ignores
consumer.line: Farmers don't doubt that Nitrophos and CAN work, but they won't bet a season on a switch nobody has shown them how to make without waste.
consumer.short: Farmers won't bet a season on a switch nobody has shown them how to make without waste.
evidence: Mixing is the largest subject in the file: 220 of 1,433 comments, 83 about NP or CAN, 33 putting Nitrophos beside Engro Zabardast.
"Zabrdast urea ma zink ha aur np ma phosphorus ha to akthy dalen gy to zink phosphorus to fix ho jay ge" (together they lock up).
Translated from Urdu: "How many bags of Sarsabz Nitrophos give the same result as one DAP, or can it not replace DAP?"
"Fatima fertilizer walon ne NP+CAN+ZINC SULFATE mila ke chatta kiya hai... aap bol rahai in ko aapus main na milaain" (Fatima mixed them; you say don't).
panel: The fear is waste, not failure. Nobody questions whether NP and CAN raise yield; they ask whether mixing will lock it up.
No comment mentions the 10% promise. One asks whether CAN raises yield at all.
Farmers are getting contradictory advice - including Fatima's own field practice against the creators they watch.
consumer.source: Source: 1,433 YouTube comments on independent agronomy channels (comments/analysis.md). Self-selected corpus, channels not supplied - not a measure of what most farmers think. Translations labelled.

category.title: What everyone else does, and what it leaves open
category.line: Engro has made itself the farmer's adviser and Sarsabz makes the loudest yield promise, but no brand shows the result on a real field beside the old way.
category.short: Engro advises and Sarsabz asserts, but nobody shows the result beside the old way.
evidence: Engro answers a farmer objection in 58% of its 110 uploads; Sarsabz in 6% of its 90.
Engro: 44 advisory uploads, 31 with a named agronomist, soil testing, a cost-per-acre podcast, retail centres and an app.
Sarsabz makes the yield claim 15 times, Engro 0 - and 10 of Sarsabz's 11 '10%' films offer nothing but the badge.
FFC Sona, Bubber Sher and Agritech Tara have no official YouTube channel.
category.panel_title: Why the category behaves this way
panel: Urea and DAP are near-commodities, so Engro competes on what comes with the bag: a zinc coating, advice, a service.
Sarsabz sells products no rival makes at scale - the only CAN and 93% of NP - so proof is its natural ground, and the one it is not using.
The space is not empty because it failed: Ki Jeet, the closest thing to field proof, carries Sarsabz's biggest product films (8.2M, 7.5M views).
category.source: Source: 200 owned YouTube uploads coded on the same schema, 15 Sep 2024 - 15 Sep 2026 (scan/scan_findings.md); presence sweep 15 Sep 2026. Views are bought media weight, not share of voice.

brand.title: What Sarsabz has, and what it faces
brand.from: FROM THE BRIEF AND MARKET DATA
brand.line: Sarsabz holds proof no rival can produce - the only CAN and 93% of NP in Pakistan, 500+ demo plots, Ki Jeet winners in 34 districts - but keeps it off screen, so farmers know the product and forget the name.
brand.short: Sarsabz holds proof no rival can produce, but keeps it off screen - farmers know the product and forget the name.
evidence: The asset: Fatima Group holds 93% of NP and is the sole CAN producer; Engro holds 6% of NP (CCP Table 11, NFDC 2022-23).
The proof exists: the promise is "documented by... 500+ demo plots" (brief p5); Ki Jeet wins in 34 of 40 districts. No plot appears in 90 uploads.
The name is missing: farmers mention CAN 193 times and NP 147 times, Sarsabz 15 times.
brand.panel_title: Where the brief and the evidence disagree
panel: Brief: the brand "evolved from being a product-focused brand to a farmer-centric brand" (p13). Evidence: farmers judge at product level, and Engro is winning there.
Brief: 22% top-of-mind "exceeded competition's TOM awareness by 6%" (p29). Chart: true against Competitor 2 only - Competitor 1 is at 62%.
The brief's own pillar is "Experts" (p5). On screen, Sarsabz shows 0 named agronomists; Engro shows 31.
brand.source: Source: Fatima Creative Marketing Brief 2026 (pp.5, 13, 29); CCP Competition Assessment, DRAFT, Jul 2025. PROVISIONAL: demo-plot data, current product share and the brand-health study method were not supplied.

idea.title: Three insights, one organising thought
idea.line: Sarsabz proves itself on a field like yours.
idea.meaning: The 10% stops being a badge and becomes a result a farmer can see on a field like his - with the recipe that produced it: what replaced DAP, what it was mixed with, on which irrigation, on what soil.
idea.test: remove any one insight and the idea fails - without the farmer it is demo-plot PR nobody asked for, without the category it is Engro's advice, without the brand anyone could promise a demo, but only Sarsabz makes the NP and CAN on the winning side of it.

strategy.title: Strategy statement and comms platform
strategy.statement: Re-frame Sarsabz from a yield promise farmers take on trust to the proof they can see and copy, by putting its demo plots and winning farmers side by side with DAP + urea on fields like theirs, and publishing the recipe behind every result.

why.relevant: answers the largest subject in the farmer conversation - how to switch without waste.
why.distinctive: Engro advises, Sarsabz asserts, and nobody in 200 uploads shows a result beside the old way.
why.ownable: only the maker of 93% of NP and all of CAN can put those products on the winning side of the comparison.

alternatives.name: A. Sarsabz proves itself on a field like yours.
alternatives.tradeoff: Built on all three insights. Needs Fatima to publish plot results - including the ones that fell short.

alternatives.name: B. The farmer's trusted adviser.
alternatives.tradeoff: Engro's territory: 44 advisory uploads, 31 named experts. Sarsabz would arrive second in a space Engro already owns.

alternatives.name: C. Saluting the farmer - Sarsabz Pakistan.
alternatives.tradeoff: Where the brand talks today (30 of 90 uploads) and right for Salam Kissan. But farmers name Sarsabz 15 times in 1,433 comments; a salute does not sell a switch.

strategy.swap_test: Engro could film a demo plot. It cannot put NP and CAN on the winning side - it has 6% of NP and no CAN. Lead with that.

commitments.title: What it asks of Fatima, and how it lives in media
commitments.asks_title: What Fatima must commit to - before any line is written

asks.name: Publish the plots
asks.detail: Demo-plot results by crop, district and soil - including those under 10%.

asks.name: Correct Ki Jeet
asks.detail: State winners' yields and inputs; drop 'proved 10%'; verify before saying 'all winners'.

asks.name: One mixing answer
asks.detail: An official NP and CAN compatibility and timing guide, so field staff and creators agree.

asks.name: Name the recipe
asks.detail: Every proof film names the farmer, district, soil, inputs and maunds.

asks.name: Answer in the thread
asks.detail: Agronomists staffing the Sarsabz Pakistan App and comment replies.

commitments.channel_insight: The switch is decided in agronomy creators' comment threads, where farmers ask strangers what the maker should be telling them - and suspect the answers are paid.

media_principles.name: Show the field, not the badge.
media_principles.detail: Every yield claim points to a named plot or farmer.

media_principles.name: Short points to long.
media_principles.detail: The 15-second cut carries the result; the funded long cut carries the recipe.

media_principles.name: Be in the creator thread, disclosed.
media_principles.detail: Farmers suspect paid advice - label every partnership.

media_principles.name: Use the reach for proof.
media_principles.detail: 1.2M on TikTok and 396K on YouTube - proof clips, not prizes.

media_principles.name: The dealer is the last field.
media_principles.detail: AgriMart and dealers carry the side-by-side at the point of sale.

commitments.conclusion: If Fatima will not publish plot results, the idea becomes an assertion again. Run Ki Jeet winner stories with corrected claims instead, and state the trade-off.
